 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pranay Verma

 Misc. Petition No. 1509 of 2025
 Icici Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd Through Its
 Branch Manager
 Versus
 Rajendra Kumar And Others
 Appearance:

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Kunal Jain - advocate for the petitioner.

Order 
This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, against the order dated 17.05.2024 passed in MACC No.480/2023 by Second Member, MACT, District Dhar, whereby claim of the respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. Facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was filed on 27.10.2023 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 15.06.2022 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication.

Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:9557 2 MP-1509-2025 MACC No.480/2023.
4.
I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
